sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
Nogami Gensai
Kuro
He offers Wolf to join forces against Juzou the Drunkard and his bandits.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- Hirata Estate - Main Hall: by the pond just before Juzou the Drunkard.
In the alternate version of the Hirata Estate memory, his corpse is found on the ground with a Fistful of Ash in his hand, next to Juzou the Drunkard and Lone Shadow Masanari the Fellblade.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter | Nogami: You've done well to come this far. For a rogue, you are a worthy shinobi. My duty is to protect the young lord, lord Kuro!Lord Isshin would never forgive me should I fail. Let us fight together!
Charging at Bandits | Nogami: Hear me! My name is Nogami Gensai! I stood with the Ashina when they claimed this land!
Surviving the fight | Nogami: (Panting) That fight was hard...on this old body... Go on ahead.
If the Bandits were killed without his help | Nogami: Hmm... Looks like this place is clear.
Killed by Bandits | Nogami: I...I've failed... Lord... Ku...ro...
Attacked by Wolf | Nogami:
What are you doing?!
Stop!
Turned hostile | Nogami: Nothing but a rogue after all! I am betrayed!
When killed | Nogami: You...bastard... You...have no honor...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can't be infected by Dragonrot.
- Wolf can't harm him while Nogami is helping the shinobi fight the bandits.
- If killed while fighting the Bandits, he'll keep on respawning as long as Juzuo is alive.
- Once Juzuo is defeated, Gensai will disappear from the game for the rest of the playthrough, upon reloading the area.
